title: NEUROSCAN: Clinical Brain MRI Tumor Diagnostic Engine with Explainable AI (Grad-CAM) and From-Scratch Convolutional Architecture
description: Clinical artificial intelligence diagnostic platform for brain tumor detection and multi-class classification in T1 contrast-enhanced MRI scans with Grad-CAM explainability.
